questions.stem: 當手機沒電時，有些人甚至會在自己走了好幾年的路線上迷路。
questions.answer: When their phones run out of battery, some people even get lost on the routes they have taken for years.
accepted_answers: When their phone batteries die, some people may even get lost on a route that they have used for years.
When the batteries of their phones run out, some people can even get lost on routes they have taken for many years.

patterns: 形容詞子句（省略受格關係代名詞）

questions.stem: 為了找回方向感，許多上班族開始嘗試名為定向越野（orienteering）的戶外運動。
questions.answer: To get back their sense of direction, many office workers have started trying an outdoor sport called orienteering.
accepted_answers: In order to regain their sense of direction, many office workers have begun to try an outdoor sport called orienteering.
To recover their sense of direction, many office workers have started to try an outdoor sport known as orienteering.

1.explanation_zh: 「當手機沒電時」是時間副詞子句 When their phones run out of battery，子句用現在式（不加 will）；手機「沒電」是 run out of battery 或 die。「甚至會迷路」寫 even get lost，even 放在動詞前面（有助動詞時放在助動詞後面）。「自己走了好幾年的路線」中文修飾語在前，英文改成 the routes (that) they have taken for years：先寫名詞，再接形容詞子句；「走了好幾年」從過去持續到現在，用現在完成式。
evidence: 自己走了好幾年的路線
1.strategy_zh: 「…的＋名詞」修飾語很長時，英文先寫名詞，再用 that／which 子句放在後面；受格關係代名詞可以省略。
hints: 切成四段：當手機沒電時／有些人甚至會／在自己走了好幾年的路線上／迷路
標的詞彙：phone（手機，L1）、battery（電池，L4）、even（甚至，L1）、lost（迷路的，L1）、route（路線，L4）
句型框架：When + S + V(現在式), S + even get lost on + the N + (that) S + have + p.p. …

2.explanation_zh: 「為了找回方向感」表目的，用不定詞 To get back（或 In order to regain）their sense of direction 放句首；「方向感」是 sense of direction。「開始嘗試」用現在完成式 have started trying（start 後面接 V-ing 或 to VR）。「名為定向越野的戶外運動」中文修飾語在前，英文用過去分詞片語後位修飾：an outdoor sport called orienteering；outdoor 以母音開頭，冠詞用 an。
evidence: 名為定向越野（orienteering）的戶外運動
2.strategy_zh: 「名為／叫做…的 N」直接套 N + called …；「為了…」放句首時寫 To + 原形動詞，後面加逗號。
hints: 切成四段：為了找回方向感／許多上班族／開始嘗試／名為定向越野（orienteering）的戶外運動
標的詞彙：get back（找回）、sense of direction（方向感，L2）、office worker（上班族，L1）、start（開始，L1）、outdoor（戶外的，L3）、sport（運動，L2）、call（稱為，L1）
句型框架：To + VR …, S + have started + V-ing + a/an + N + called + 名稱

When their phone batteries die, some people may even get lost on a route that they have used for years.
When the batteries of their phones run out, some people can even get lost on routes they have taken for many years.

traps.zh: 自己走了好幾年的路線
traps.literal_error: When their phones run out of battery, some people even get lost on the walked-for-years routes.
traps.explanation_zh: 「自己走了好幾年的路線」照中文語序把修飾語放在名詞前面是錯的；英文要寫 the routes (that) they have taken for years。

traps.literal_error: When their phones have no electricity, some people even get lost on the routes they have taken for years.
traps.explanation_zh: 手機「沒電」的搭配是 run out of battery 或 die；no electricity 是停電、沒有電力供應。

1.restructuring_zh: 「自己走了好幾年的路線」是放在名詞前面的長修飾語；英文要先寫名詞 the routes，後面接形容詞子句 (that) they have taken for years，關係代名詞當受詞時可以省略。
1.notes_zh: 「手機沒電」run out of battery／power、the batteries die、die、be dead 都給分，phone 單數或複數都可以；「會」可寫 may、can、will 或不寫；「路線」routes／route、roads、way、path 都可以，關係代名詞 that／which 可省略；「走了好幾年」have taken／used／walked／traveled … for (many／several) years，也可以寫 have been taking；「迷路」get lost、lose their way 都可以。

運動是「被叫做」orienteering，用過去分詞 called。
outdoor 以母音開頭，冠詞用 an。

traps.zh: 名為定向越野（orienteering）的戶外運動
traps.literal_error: To get back their sense of direction, many office workers have started trying a called orienteering outdoor sport.
traps.explanation_zh: 「名為…的戶外運動」中文修飾語在前；英文要先寫 an outdoor sport，再用 called orienteering 放在後面。

traps.literal_error: For getting back their sense of direction, many office workers have started trying an outdoor sport called orienteering.
traps.explanation_zh: 「為了…」表目的要用不定詞 To／In order to + 原形動詞；for + V-ing 不表示目的。

2.restructuring_zh: 「名為定向越野的戶外運動」中文修飾語在前；英文要先寫名詞 an outdoor sport，再用過去分詞片語 called orienteering 放在後面修飾。
2.notes_zh: 「為了」To 或 In order to 都可以；「找回」get back、regain、recover 都給分，their／a sense of direction 都可以；「上班族」office workers，也可寫 white-collar workers、office employees；「開始嘗試」have started／begun trying 或 to try 都可以，也可用過去式 started、began，或 have taken up；「名為」called、named、known as 都給分，「運動」寫 sport 或 activity 都可以。

1.translation: When their phones run out of battery, some people even get lost on routes that they have walked for years.
1.explanation_zh: 「當…時」用 when 副詞子句，描述一般情況用現在簡單式；「沒電」用 run out of battery（也可 die、run out of power）；「自己走了好幾年的路線」用 that 關係子句修飾 routes，子句內「走了好幾年」是延續到現在，用現在完成式 have walked for years。

2.translation: In order to regain their sense of direction, many office workers have started to try an outdoor sport called orienteering.
2.explanation_zh: 「為了找回」表目的，用 In order to regain；「方向感」是 sense of direction；「開始嘗試」是近來開始且仍持續，用 have started to try；「名為定向越野的戶外運動」用過去分詞片語 called orienteering 後位修飾 sport。

1.translation: When their phones run out of battery, some people even get lost on routes that they have walked for several years.
1.explanation_zh: 「手機沒電」用 run out of battery；「甚至」用 even；「走了好幾年的路線」用關係子句加現在完成式 have walked for several years，表示持續到現在的經驗。也可改成 have been walking，但此處用完成式較自然。

2.translation: To regain their sense of direction, many office workers have started to try an outdoor sport called orienteering.
2.explanation_zh: 「為了找回方向感」用不定詞片語 To regain their sense of direction 表目的；「開始嘗試」用現在完成式 have started to try（近來的趨勢）；「名為…的」用過去分詞 called。
